commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The identifiers entry_is_line_a, entry_is_line_b, entry_is_line_c, entry_is_line_d, and entry_is_line_e are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Chapter 78's authority-membership predicates were identity tests against five exemplar HTS lines from other chapters, so no chapter 78 lead entry could ever satisfy them and the chapter's section 301 / section 232 / section 201 / reciprocal-exclusion components were constant zero irrespective of the cited Chapter 99 note lists.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 72; verified the post-fix file still references the flags 19 times with no remaining local definitions. No exemplar line belongs to chapter 78. Same doubt as index 72.
triage.verifier_justification: I tried to reduce this to mechanical or not_a_defect and could not: the diff deletes five whole derived rules (formulas plus proof atoms) from ch73.yaml and converts their identifiers into implicit caller inputs, so formulas, rule set, and input surface all change. The deleted rules pinned chapter 73's membership predicates to single HTS lines from other chapters (7202.11.10.00, 7601.10.30.00, 9506.62.40.40, 2203.00.00.30, 8541.42.00.10), none of which exists in the ch73 rate table this module imports (us/policies/usitc/us-tariff-duty/lines/generated/ch73.yaml contains only 73xx lines, and a missing key deliberately raises), so entry_is_line_a..e were identically false and every component gated on them (china_section_301_component_rate, section_201/232-aluminum/338, entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded, entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded) was inert for every chapter 73 entry. The pinned release confirms the disagreement with the cited source: 9903.01.33 reads "Articles of iron or steel; derivative articles of iron or steel; articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum; ...", yet the module encoded that exclusion as one aluminum line (its own proof excerpt truncates to "articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum"). That is a condition grounded on the wrong provision that the fix removes, which is untraceable_branch as defined.
triage.verifier_notes: inferred from verified sibling module index 72 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Kept the first reader's classification and kind, with caveats a reviewer should see. (1) This commit only deletes the definitions; every consuming formula in ch73 is byte-identical (section_122_component_rate still reads "if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0" at post line 2572, and china_section_301_component_rate still has five exemplar slots), so the repair is delegation to entry preparation, not in-module re-grounding — the PR body's §122 regating and the steel component land in later commits of PR #1300. (2) The exemplar-copy pattern survives this commit: entry_is_energy_resource is still hard-coded as hts_number == "7202.11.10.00" in the post file (line 1951), so ch73 still carries a chapter-72 ferroalloy grounding for an IEEPA energy-scope predicate — a live follow-on defect worth filing separately. (3) The retained summary sentence "Values, dates, dtypes, proof atoms, and runtime semantics are unchanged" is scoped to the sibling-distinctness serialization device (redundant parens and ch73_ scalar prefixes), not to the flag change; read against the flag change it is false, since derived rules became caller inputs. (4) The first reader's quote is from the new module comment, which is not itself the defect evidence; the decisive evidence is the deleted formula lines plus PR #1300's statement that the witness's exemplar coupling "unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins". (5) Closest alternative kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (a witness five-line panel population copied onto chapter 73's population); I did not reclassify because the taxonomy puts "formulas grounded on the wrong provision" and fixes that remove the branch under untraceable_branch. (6) The file is module.kind: composition — generator output from tools/generate_schedule_compositions.py (in other_files), regenerated across 100 chapters — so the defect is one generator bug replicated per chapter, not 100 independent findings; corpus de-duplication should account for that.
